summary: Today’s market tone is mixed but risk-on in parts of equities and some commodities, while major crypto remains under pressure and several analysts are leaning bearish on BTC and ETH. The strongest fresh themes are selective strength in semiconductors and a continued bid in Brent and gold, alongside scattered short-term bearish crypto calls from market commentaries.
